purpose: Broaden the Stage 0 standard-image proof from static RGBA filter-0 PNG to an explicit 8-bit non-interlaced PNG variant suite while keeping Mechagotchi semantics sidecar-bound.

external_anchors.used_for: PNG color type, bit depth, filter method, filter type, PLTE, IDAT, CRC, and Adam7 boundary semantics.

variant_specs.description: 8-bit RGBA truecolor with alpha and filter type 0.
8-bit RGBA truecolor with alpha cycling filters 0 through 4.
8-bit grayscale visual carrier using Up filtering.
8-bit indexed-color carrier with PLTE and Average/Paeth filtering.

limitations: Stage 0 variant decoder supports 8-bit non-interlaced PNG only.
Supported color types are grayscale, truecolor, indexed color, and truecolor with alpha.
Semantic metadata is restored from the Mechagotchi sidecar, not inferred from pixels.
Adam7 interlace, APNG, 16-bit channels, and grayscale-alpha are not claimed.
